name: Bridge Ds
description: AI-powered design generation in Figma using your real design system. Bridge extracts your DS (components, tokens, styles), writes validated specs, and generates production-ready Figma designs with 100% DS compliance — zero hardcoded values, real component instances, bound variables. Features a unique learning loop that captures your corrections and improves future generations. Supports both figma-console-mcp and the official Figma MCP server.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**, **1 hook** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (5): `extracting-design-system` (Use when the user says "setup", "setup bridge", "extract", "extract DS", "onboard", "build knowledge base", "initialize bridge", or…), `generating-figma-design` (Use when the user requests to design, create, build, generate, or make a new Figma component or screen…), `learning-from-corrections` (Use when the user says they adjusted the design in Figma, mentions "fix", "correct", "learn from", "I changed",…), `shipping-and-archiving` (Use when the user says "done", "ship it", "finish", "complete", "archive", or otherwise indicates the current design is…), `using-bridge` (Use when any Bridge command is invoked (make, fix, done, setup, drop, status) or any Figma / design-system…)
- **Hooks** (1): `SessionStart`
- **MCP servers** (1): `figma-console`

Installs with `claude plugin install bridge-ds@claude-community` from `noemuch/bridge`.
